description: This file defines the interface 'ThingsSearchPersistence' which specifies various methods for interacting with a persistence layer used in a search service. It includes methods for initializing indices, generating reports, counting documents, finding document IDs with and without limits, and streaming metadata. The interface is part of a package related to search persistence and is used to abstract persistence operations for the 'thingsearch' feature in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ThingsSearchPersistence
classes.description: Interface for thing operations on the persistence used within the search service. It declares methods for initializing indices, generating reports, performing counts, and streaming search results and metadata.

methods.name: initializeIndices
methods.description: Initializes the search index if necessary, returning a CompletionStage for asynchronous operation.

methods.name: generateNamespaceCountReport
methods.description: Generates a report of things per namespace as a reactive stream.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns a reactive stream emitting the count of search results for the given query, filtered by authorization subject IDs.

methods.name: sudoCount
methods.description: Returns a reactive stream emitting the count of search results for the given query, ignoring visibility restrictions.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of all matching documents with optional namespace filtering.

methods.name: findAllUnlimited
methods.description: Streams IDs of all matching documents without size limit, with optional namespace filtering.

methods.name: sudoStreamMetadata
methods.description: Streams metadata of all search index entries not marked for deletion, without considering authorization.
